description: Source code for AndroidResourcesPackagingCompiler class, which implements a compiler for packaging Android resources within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: MyItem
classes.description: Represents a processing item for packaging Android resources, including module info, manifest, resource directories, output path, and build options.

classes.name: MyValidityState
classes.description: Validity state for resource packaging, tracking output file existence, build options, and platform revision.

methods.name: getProcessingItems
methods.description: Collects and returns processing items for each relevant Android module in the project.

methods.name: collectAssetDirs
methods.description: Collects asset directories from the module's Android facet and its dependencies.

methods.name: getOutputFile
methods.description: Determines the output file path for the module's packaged resources.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs resource packaging for each processing item, including full build check and error handling.

methods.name: doProcess
methods.description: Handles the actual resource packaging process, including manifest preprocessing and resource compilation.

methods.name: copyManifestAndSetDebuggableToTrue
methods.description: Creates a copy of the AndroidManifest.xml with the debuggable attribute set to true, used for debug builds.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the compiler.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the compiler configuration; always returns true in this implementation.

methods.name: createValidityState
methods.description: Creates a new validity state object based on input data.
